Alif Laam Raa. Yeh woh kitaab hai jis ki aayatein muhkam banaayi gayi hain aur ek saahib-e-ilm o hikmat ki taraf se tafseel ke saath bayaan ki gayi hain
Ke Allah ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karo. Main usi ki taraf se daraane waala aur bashaarat dene waala hoon

Aur apne Rab se istighfaar karo, phir us ki taraf mutawajjeh ho jaao, woh tum ko muqarrara muddat mein behtareen faaida ata karega aur saahib-e-fazl ko us ke fazl ka haq dega, aur main tumhaare baare mein ek bade din ke azaab se khaufzada hoon
Tum sab ki baazgasht Khuda hi ki taraf hai aur woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Aagaah ho jaao ke yeh log apne seenon ko dohraaye le rahe hain ke is tarah Paighambar se chhup jaayein. To aagaah rahein ke yeh jab apne kapdon ko khoob lapet lete hain to us waqt bhi woh un ke zaahir o baatin donon ko jaanta hai, ke woh tamaam seenon ke raazon ka jaanne waala hai

Aur zameen par chalne waali koi makhlooq aisi nahin hai jis ka rizq Khuda ke zimme na ho. Woh har ek ke saunpe jaane ki jagah aur us ke qaraar ki manzil ko jaanta hai, aur sab kuch kitaab-e-mubeen mein mahfooz hai

Aur wahi woh hai jis ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko chhe dinon mein paida kiya hai aur us ka takht-e-iqtidaar paani par tha, taake tumhein aazmaaye ke tum mein sab se behtar amal karne waala kaun hai. Aur agar aap kahenge ke tum log maut ke baad phir uthaaye jaane waale ho to yeh kaafir kahenge ke yeh to sirf ek khula hua jaadu hai

Aur agar hum un ke azaab ko ek mu'ayyana muddat ke liye taal dein to tanz karenge ke azaab ko kis cheez ne rok liya hai. Aagaah ho jaao ke jis din azaab aa jaaega to phir palatne waala nahin hai, aur phir woh azaab un ko har taraf se gher lega jis ka yeh mazaaq uda rahe the
Aur agar hum insaan ko rehmat de kar chheen lete hain to maayoos ho jaata hai aur kufr karne lagta hai
Aur agar takleef pahunchne ke baad ne'mat aur aaraam ka maza chakha dete hain to kehta hai ke ab to hamaari saari buraaiyaan chali gayin, aur woh khush ho kar akadne lagta hai
Ilaawa un logon ke jo imaan laaye hain aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hain, ke un ke liye maghfirat hai aur bahut bada ajr bhi hai

Pas kya tum hamaari wahi ke ba'z hisson ko is liye tark karne waale ho, ya is se tumhaara seena is liye tang hua hai ke yeh log kahenge ke un ke oopar khazaana kyon nahin naazil hua ya un ke saath farishta kyon nahin aaya? To aap sirf azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waale hain aur Allah har shai ka nigraan aur zimmedaar hai

Kya yeh log kehte hain ke yeh Quran bande ne gadh liya hai? To keh dijiye ke is ke jaise das soorah gadh kar tum bhi le aao, aur Allah ke ilaawa jis ko chaaho apni madad ke liye bula lo, agar tum apni baat mein sachche ho
Phir agar yeh aap ki baat qubool na karein to tum sab samajh lo ke jo kuch naazil kiya gaya hai sab Khuda ke ilm se hai, aur us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, to kya ab tum Islam laane waale ho
Jo shakhs zindagaani-e-duniya aur us ki zeenat hi chaahta hai hum us ke aamaal ka poora poora hisaab yaheen kar dete hain aur kisi tarah ki kami nahin karte hain
Aur yahi woh hain jin ke liye aakhirat mein Jahannam ke ilaawa kuch nahin hai, aur un ke saare kaarobaar barbaad ho gaye hain aur saare aamaal baatil o be-asar ho gaye hain

Kya jo shakhs apne Rab ki taraf se khuli daleel rakhta hai aur us ke peechhe us ka gawaah bhi hai, aur us se pehle Moosa ki kitaab gawaahi de rahi hai jo qaum ke liye peshwa aur rehmat thi, woh iftira karega? Beshak saahibaan-e-imaan isi par imaan rakhte hain, aur jo log is ka inkaar karte hain un ka thikaana Jahannam hai. To khabardaar tum is Quran ki taraf se shak mein mubtala na hona, yeh Khuda ki taraf se barhaq hai, agarche aksar log is par imaan nahin laate hain

Aur us se bada zaalim kaun hai jo Allah par jhoota ilzaam lagaata hai? Yahi woh log hain jo Khuda ke saamne pesh kiye jaayenge to saare gawaah gawaahi denge ke un logon ne Khuda ke baare mein ghalat-bayaani se kaam liya hai. To aagaah ho jaao ke zaalimeen par Khuda ki la'nat hai
Jo raah-e-Khuda se rokte hain aur us mein kaji paida karna chaahte hain aur aakhirat ke baare mein kufr aur inkaar karne waale hain

Yeh log na roo-e-zameen mein Khuda ko aajiz kar sakte hain aur na Khuda ke ilaawa un ka koi naasir o madadgaar hai. Un ka azaab dugna kar diya jaaega ke yeh na haq baat sun sakte the aur na us ke manzar-e-aam ko dekh sakte the
Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne khud apne nafs ko khasaare mein mubtala kiya aur un se woh bhi gum ho gaye jin ka iftira kiya karte the
Yaqeenan yeh log aakhirat mein bahut bada ghaata uthaane waale hain
Beshak jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal anjaam diye aur apne Rab ki baargaah mein aajizi se pesh aaye, wahi ahl-e-jannat hain aur us mein hamesha rehne waale hain
Kaafir aur Musalmaan ki misaal andhe behre aur dekhne sunne waale ki hai, to kya yeh donon misaal ke e'tebaar se baraabar ho sakte hain? Tumhein hosh kyon nahin aata hai
Aur hum ne Nooh ko un ki qaum ki taraf is paighaam ke saath bheja ke main tumhaare liye khule hue azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala hoon
Aur yeh ke khabardaar tum Allah ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karna, ke main tumhaare baare mein dardnaak din ke azaab ka khauf rakhta hoon

To un ki qaum ke bade log jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya tha, unhon ne kaha ke hum to tum ko apna hi jaisa ek insaan samajh rahe hain, aur tumhaare ittibaa' karne waalon ko dekhte hain ke woh hamaare past tabqe ke saada-lauh afraad hain. Hum tum mein apne oopar koi fazeelat nahin dekhte hain balke tumhein jhoota khayaal karte hain

Unhon ne jawaab diya ke ae qaum! Tumhaara kya khayaal hai ke agar main apne Parwardigar ki taraf se daleel rakhta hoon aur woh mujhe apni taraf se woh rehmat ata kar de jo tumhein dikhaai na de, to kya main naagawaari ke ba-wujood zabardasti tumhaare oopar laad sakta hoon

Ae qaum! Main tum se koi maal to nahin chaahta hoon, mera ajr to Allah ke zimme hai, aur main saahibaan-e-imaan ko nikaal bhi nahin sakta hoon ke woh log apne Parwardigar se mulaaqaat karne waale hain, albatta main tum ko ek jaahil qaum tasawwur kar raha hoon
Ae qaum! Main un logon ko nikaal baahar kar doon to Allah ki taraf se mera madadgaar kaun hoga? Kya tumhein hosh nahin aata hai

Aur main tum se yeh bhi nahin kehta hoon ke mere paas tamaam Khudaai khazaane maujood hain, aur na har ghaib ke jaanne ka da'wa karta hoon, aur na yeh kehta hoon ke main farishta hoon, aur na jo log tumhaari nigaahon mein zaleel hain un ke baare mein yeh kehta hoon ke Khuda inhein khair na dega. Allah un ke dilon se khoob baakhabar hai. Main aisa keh doonga to zaalimon mein shumaar ho jaaoonga
Un logon ne kaha ke Nooh! Aap ne hum se jhagda kiya aur bahut jhagda kiya, to ab jis cheez ka wa'da kar rahe the use le aao agar tum apne da'we mein sachche ho
Nooh ne kaha ke woh to Khuda le aaega agar chaahega, aur tum use aajiz bhi nahin kar sakte ho

Aur main tumhein naseehat bhi karna chaahoon to meri naseehat tumhaare kaam nahin aaegi agar Khuda hi tum ko gumraahi mein chhod dena chaahe. Wahi tumhaara Parwardigar hai aur usi ki taraf tum palat kar jaane waale ho
Kya yeh log yeh kehte hain ke unhon ne apne paas se gadh liya hai? To aap keh dijiye ke agar main ne gadha hai to us ka jurm mere zimme hai, aur main tumhaare jaraaim se bari aur bezaar hoon
Aur Nooh ki taraf yeh wahi ki gayi ke tumhaari qaum mein se ab koi imaan na laaega ilaawa un ke jo imaan la chuke, lihaaza tum un ke af'aal se ranjeeda na ho
Aur hamaari nigaahon ke saamne hamaari wahi ki nigraani mein kashti taiyaar karo, aur zaalimon ke baare mein mujh se baat na karo ke yeh sab gharq ho jaane waale hain

Aur Nooh kashti bana rahe the aur jab bhi qaum ki kisi jamaa'at ka guzar hota tha to un ka mazaaq udaate the. Nooh ne kaha ke agar tum hamaara mazaaq udaaoge to kal hum isi tarah tumhaara bhi mazaaq udaayenge
Phir anqareeb tumhein maaloom ho jaaega ke jis ke paas azaab aata hai use ruswa kar diya jaata hai aur phir woh azaab daaimi hi ho jaata hai

Yahaan tak ke jab hamaara hukm aa gaya aur tannoor se paani ubalne laga to hum ne kaha ke Nooh! Apne saath har jode mein se do ko le lo, aur apne ahl ko bhi le lo ilaawa un ke jin ke baare mein halaakat ka faisla ho chuka hai, aur saahibaan-e-imaan ko bhi le lo, aur un ke saath imaan waale bahut hi kam the
Nooh ne kaha ke ab tum sab kashti mein sawaar ho jaao, Khuda ke naam ke sahaare is ka bahaao bhi hai aur thehraao bhi, aur beshak mera Parwardigar bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Aur woh kashti inhein le kar pahaadon jaisi maujon ke darmiyaan chali ja rahi thi ke Nooh ne apne farzand ko aawaaz di jo alag jagah par tha ke farzand! Hamaare saath kashti mein sawaar ho ja aur kaafiron mein na ho ja

Us ne kaha ke main anqareeb pahaad par panaah le loonga, woh mujhe paani se bacha lega. Nooh ne kaha ke aaj hukm-e-Khuda se koi bachaane waala nahin hai siwaaye us ke jis par khud Khuda reham kare. Aur phir donon ke darmiyaan mauj haail ho gayi aur woh doobne waalon mein shaamil ho gaya

Aur qudrat ka hukm hua ke ae zameen! Apne paani ko nigal le, aur ae aasmaan! Apne paani ko rok le. Aur phir paani ghat gaya aur kaam tamaam kar diya gaya, aur kashti koh-e-Joodi par thehar gayi, aur aawaaz aayi ke halaakat qaum-e-zaalimeen ke liye hai
Aur Nooh ne apne Parwardigar ko pukaara ke Parwardigar! Mera farzand mere ahl mein se hai aur tera wa'da ahl ko bachaane ka barhaq hai, aur tu behtareen faisla karne waala hai

Irshaad hua ke Nooh! Yeh tumhaare ahl se nahin hai, yeh amal-e-ghair-saaleh hai, lihaaza mujh se us cheez ke baare mein sawaal na karo jis ka tumhein ilm nahin hai. Main tumhein naseehat karta hoon ke tumhaara shumaar jaahilon mein na ho jaaye

Nooh ne kaha ke Khudaya! Main is baat se panaah maangta hoon ke us cheez ka sawaal karoon jis ka ilm na ho, aur agar tu mujhe maaf na karega aur mujh par reham na karega to main khasaare waalon mein ho jaaoonga

Irshaad hua ke Nooh! Hamaari taraf se salaamati aur barkaton ke saath kashti se utro. Yeh salaamati aur barkat tumhaare saath ki qaum par hai, aur kuch qaumein hain jinhein hum pehle raahat denge, us ke baad hamaari taraf se dardnaak azaab milega

Paighambar! Yeh ghaib ki khabrein hain jin ki hum aap ki taraf wahi kar rahe hain, jin ka ilm na aap ko tha aur na aap ki qaum ko, lihaaza aap sabr karein ke anjaam saahibaan-e-taqwa ke haath mein hai
Aur hum ne qaum-e-Aad ki taraf un ke bhaai Hood ko bheja to unhon ne kaha qaum waalo! Allah ki ibaadat karo, us ke ilaawa tumhaara koi ma'bood nahin hai. Tum sirf iftira karne waale ho
Qaum waalo! Main tum se kisi ujrat ka sawaal nahin karta, mera ajr to us Parwardigar ke zimme hai jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai. Kya tum aql isti'maal nahin karte ho

Ae qaum! Khuda se istighfaar karo, us ke baad us ki taraf hama-tan mutawajjeh ho jaao, woh aasmaan se moosla-dhaar paani barsaaega aur tumhaari maujooda quwwat mein quwwat ka izaafa kar dega, aur khabardaar mujrimon ki tarah munh na pher lena
Un logon ne kaha ae Hood! Tum koi mo'jiza to laaye nahin, aur hum sirf tumhaare kehne par apne khudaaon ko chhodne waale aur tumhaari baat par imaan laane waale nahin hain

Hum sirf yeh kehna chaahte hain ke hamaare khudaaon mein se kisi ne aap ko deewaana bana diya hai. Hood ne kaha ke main Khuda ko gawaah bana kar kehta hoon aur tum bhi gawaah rehna ke main tumhaare shirk se bezaar hoon
Lihaaza tum sab mil kar mere saath makkaari karo aur mujhe mohlat na do

Mera e'temaad Parwardigar par hai jo mera aur tumhaara sab ka Khuda hai, aur koi zameen par chalne waala aisa nahin hai jis ki peshaani us ke qabze mein na ho. Mere Parwardigar ka raasta bilkul seedha hai

Us ke baad bhi inhiraaf karo to main ne Khudaai paighaam ko pahuncha diya hai. Ab Khuda tumhaari jagah par doosri qaumon ko le aaega aur tum us ka kuch nahin bigaad sakte ho. Beshak mera Parwardigar har shai ka nigraan hai
Aur jab hamaara hukm aa gaya to hum ne Hood aur un ke saath imaan laane waalon ko apni rehmat se bacha liya aur inhein sakht azaab se najaat de di
Yeh qaum-e-Aad hai jis ne Parwardigar ki aayaton ka inkaar kiya, us ke rasoolon ki naafarmaani ki aur har zaalim o sarkash ka ittibaa' kar liya
Aur is duniya mein bhi aur qiyaamat mein bhi un ke peechhe la'nat laga di gayi hai. Aagaah ho jaao ke Aad ne apne Parwardigar ka kufr kiya, to ab Hood ki qaum Aad ke liye halaakat hi halaakat hai

Aur hum ne qaum-e-Samood ki taraf un ke bhaai Saaleh ko bheja, aur unhon ne kaha ke ae qaum! Allah ki ibaadat karo, us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai. Us ne tumhein zameen se paida kiya hai aur us mein aabaad kiya hai, ab us se istighfaar karo aur us ki taraf mutawajjeh ho jaao, ke mera Parwardigar qareeb-tar aur duaaon ka qubool karne waala hai

Un logon ne kaha ke ae Saaleh! Is se pehle tum se badi ummeedein waabasta thin. Kya tum is baat se rokte ho ke hum apne buzurgon ke ma'boodon ki parastish karein? Hum yaqeenan tumhaari daawat ki taraf se shak aur shubhe mein hain

Unhon ne kaha ae qaum! Tumhaara kya khayaal hai ke agar main apne Parwardigar ki taraf se daleel rakhta hoon aur us ne mujhe rehmat ata ki hai, to agar main us ki naafarmaani karoonga to us ke muqaable mein kaun meri madad kar sakega? Tum to ghaate mein izaafe ke ilaawa kuch nahin kar sakte ho

Ae qaum! Yeh naaqa Allah ki taraf se ek nishaani hai, ise aazaad chhod do taake zameen-e-Khuda mein chain se khaaye, aur ise kisi tarah ki takleef na dena ke tumhein jaldi hi koi azaab apni giraft mein le le
Us ke baad bhi un logon ne us ki koonchein kaat deen, to Saaleh ne kaha ke ab apne gharon mein teen din tak aur aaraam karo, ke yeh wa'da-e-Ilaahi hai jo ghalat nahin ho sakta hai

Us ke baad jab hamaara hukm-e-azaab aa pahuncha to hum ne Saaleh aur un ke saath ke saahibaan-e-imaan ko apni rehmat se apne azaab aur us din ki ruswaai se bacha liya, ke tumhaara Parwardigar saahib-e-quwwat aur sab par ghaalib hai
Aur zulm karne waalon ko ek chinghaad ne apni lapet mein le liya to woh apne dayaar mein aundhe pade reh gaye
Jaise kabhi yahaan base hi nahin the. Aagaah ho jaao ke Samood ne apne Rab ki naafarmaani ki hai, aur hoshiyaar ho jaao ke Samood ke liye halaakat hi halaakat hai
Aur Ibraheem ke paas hamaare numaainde bashaarat le kar aaye aur aa kar salaam kiya to Ibraheem ne bhi salaam kiya, aur thodi der na guzri thi ke bhuna hua bachhda le aaye
Aur jab dekha ke un logon ke haath idhar nahin badh rahe hain to ta'ajjub kiya aur un ki taraf se khauf mehsoos kiya. Unhon ne kaha ke aap darein nahin, hum qaum-e-Loot ki taraf bheje gaye hain
Ibraheem ki zauja usi jagah khadi thin, yeh sun kar hans padin to hum ne inhein Is'haaq ki bashaarat de di, aur Is'haaq ke baad phir Ya'qoob ki bashaarat di
To unhon ne kaha ke haaye museebat! Ab mere yahaan bachcha hoga jab ke main bhi boodhi hoon aur mere miyaan bhi boodhe hain, yeh to bilkul ajeeb si baat hai
Farishton ne kaha ke kya tumhein hukm-e-Ilaahi mein ta'ajjub ho raha hai? Allah ki rehmat aur barkat tum ghar waalon par hai, woh qaabil-e-hamd aur saahib-e-majd o buzurgi hai
Us ke baad jab Ibraheem ka khauf bar-taraf hua aur un ke paas bashaarat bhi aa chuki to unhon ne hum se qaum-e-Loot ke baare mein israar karna shuroo kar diya
Beshak Ibraheem bahut hi dardmand aur Khuda ki taraf rujoo' karne waale the
Ibraheem! Is baat se e'raaz karo, ab hukm-e-Khuda aa chuka hai aur un logon tak woh azaab aane waala hai jo paltaaya nahin ja sakta
Aur jab hamaare firistaade Loot ke paas pahunche to woh un ke khayaal se ranjeeda hue aur tang-dil ho gaye aur kaha ke yeh bada sakht din hai

Aur un ki qaum daudti hui aa gayi, aur is se pehle bhi yeh log aise bure kaam kar rahe the. Loot ne kaha ae qaum! Yeh hamaari ladkiyaan tumhaare liye ziyaada paakeeza hain, Khuda se daro aur mehmaanon ke baare mein mujhe sharminda na karo. Kya tum mein koi samajhdaar aadmi nahin hai
Un logon ne kaha ke aap jaante hain ke humein aap ki ladkiyon mein koi dilchaspi nahin hai, aur aap ko maaloom hai ke hum kya chaahte hain
Loot ne kaha kaash mere paas quwwat hoti ya main kisi mazboot qil'e mein panaah le sakta

To farishton ne kaha ke hum aap ke Parwardigar ke numaainde hain, yeh zaalim aap tak hargiz nahin pahunch sakte hain. Aap apne ghar waalon ko le kar raat ke kisi hisse mein chale jaaiye aur koi shakhs kisi ki taraf mud kar bhi na dekhe, siwaaye aap ki zauja ke ke us tak wahi azaab aane waala hai jo qaum tak aane waala hai. Un ka waqt-e-muqarrar hangaam-e-subh hai, aur kya subh qareeb nahin hai
Phir jab hamaara azaab aa gaya to hum ne zameen ko tah o baala kar diya aur un par musalsal khurnje-daar pattharon ki baarish kar di
Jin par Khuda ki taraf se nishaan lage hue the, aur woh basti un zaalimon se kuch door nahin hai

Aur hum ne Madyan ki taraf un ke bhaai Shu'aib ko bheja to unhon ne kaha ke ae qaum! Allah ki ibaadat kar ke us ke ilaawa tera koi khuda nahin hai, aur khabardaar naap tol mein kami na karna. Ke main tumhein bhalaai mein dekh raha hoon aur main tumhaare baare mein us din ke azaab se darta hoon jo sab ko ihaata kar lega
Ae qaum! Naap tol mein insaaf se kaam lo aur logon ko kam cheezein mat do aur roo-e-zameen mein fasaad mat phailaate phiro
Allah ki taraf ka zakheera tumhaare haq mein bahut behtar hai agar tum saahib-e-imaan ho, aur main tumhaare mu'aamalaat ka nigraan aur zimmedaar nahin hoon

Un logon ne tanz kiya ke Shu'aib! Kya tumhaari namaaz tumhein yeh hukm deti hai ke hum apne buzurgon ke ma'boodon ko chhod dein ya apne amwaal mein apni marzi ke mutaabiq tasarruf na karein? Tum to bade burdbaar aur samajhdaar maaloom hote ho

Shu'aib ne kaha ke ae qaum waalo! Tumhaara kya khayaal hai ke agar main Khuda ki taraf se roshan daleel rakhta hoon aur us ne mujhe behtareen rizq ata kar diya hai, aur main yeh bhi nahin chaahta hoon ke jis cheez se tum ko rokta hoon khud usi ki khilaaf-warzi karoon. Main to sirf islaah chaahta hoon jahaan tak mere imkaan mein ho. Meri taufeeq sirf Allah se waabasta hai, usi par mera e'temaad hai aur usi ki taraf main tawajjoh kar raha hoon
Aur ae qaum! Kaheen meri mukhaalifat tum par aisa azaab naazil na kara de jaisa azaab qaum-e-Nooh, qaum-e-Hood ya qaum-e-Saaleh par naazil hua tha, aur qaum-e-Loot bhi tum se kuch door nahin hai
Aur apne Parwardigar se istighfaar karo, us ke baad us ki taraf mutawajjeh ho jaao, ke beshak mera Parwardigar bahut meharbaan aur mohabbat karne waala hai

Un logon ne kaha ke ae Shu'aib! Aap ki aksar baatein hamaari samajh mein nahin aati hain, aur hum to aap ko apne darmiyaan kamzor hi pa rahe hain. Ke agar aap ka qabeela na hota to hum aap ko sangsaar kar dete, aur aap hum par ghaalib nahin aa sakte the

Shu'aib ne kaha ke kya mera qabeela tumhaari nigaah mein Allah se ziyaada azeez hai, aur tum ne Allah ko bilkul pas-e-pusht daal diya hai, jab ke mera Parwardigar tumhaare aamaal ka khoob ihaata kiye hue hai

Aur ae qaum! Tum apni jagah par apna kaam karo, main apna kaam kar raha hoon. Anqareeb jaan loge ke kis ke paas azaab aa kar use ruswa kar deta hai aur kaun jhoota hai. Aur intizaar karo ke main bhi tumhaare saath intizaar karne waala hoon

Aur jab hamaara hukm (azaab) aa gaya to hum ne Shu'aib aur un ke saath imaan laane waalon ko apni rehmat se bacha liya, aur zulm karne waalon ko ek chinghaad ne pakad liya to woh apne dayaar hi mein ulat palat ho gaye
Jaise kabhi yahaan base hi nahin the. Aur aagaah ho jaao ke qaum-e-Madyan ke liye waise hi halaakat hai jaise qaum-e-Samood halaak ho gayi thi
Aur hum ne Moosa ko apni nishaaniyon aur roshan daleel ke saath bheja
Fir'aun aur us ki qaum ki taraf, to logon ne Fir'aun ke hukm ka ittibaa' kar liya jab ke Fir'aun ka hukm aql o hosh waala hukm nahin tha
Woh roz-e-qiyaamat apni qaum ke aage aage chalega aur inhein Jahannam mein waarid kar dega, jo badtareen waarid hone ki jagah hai
Un logon ke peechhe is duniya mein bhi la'nat laga di gayi hai aur roz-e-qiyaamat bhi. Yeh badtareen atiyya hai jo inhein diya jaaega
Yeh chand bastiyon ki khabrein hain jo hum aap se bayaan kar rahe hain, un mein se ba'z baaqi reh gayi hain aur ba'z kat pit kar baraabar ho gayi hain

Aur hum ne un par koi zulm nahin kiya hai balke unhon ne khud apne oopar zulm kiya hai, to azaab ke aa jaane ke baad un ke woh khuda bhi kaam na aaye jinhein woh Khuda ko chhod kar pukaar rahe the, aur un khudaaon ne mazeed halaakat ke ilaawa inhein kuch nahin diya
Aur isi tarah tumhaare Parwardigar ki giraft hoti hai jab woh zulm karne waali bastiyon ko apni giraft mein le leta hai, ke us ki giraft bahut hi sakht aur dardnaak hoti hai
Is baat mein un logon ke liye nishaani paayi jaati hai jo azaab-e-aakhirat se darne waale hain. Woh din jis din tamaam log jama kiye jaayenge aur woh sab ki haaziri ka din hoga
Aur hum apne azaab ko sirf ek mu'ayyana muddat ke liye taal rahe hain
Us ke baad jis din woh aa jaaega to koi shakhs bhi izn-e-Khuda ke baghair kisi se baat bhi na kar sakega. Us din kuch badbakht honge aur kuch nekbakht
Pas jo log badbakht honge woh Jahannam mein rahenge jahaan un ke liye sirf haaye waaye aur cheekh pukaar hogi
Woh wahin hamesha rehne waale hain jab tak aasmaan o zameen qaaim hain, magar yeh ke aap ka Parwardigar nikaalna chaahe, ke woh jo bhi chaahe kar sakta hai

Aur jo log nekbakht hain woh jannat mein honge aur wahin hamesha rahenge jab tak ke aasmaan o zameen qaaim hain, magar yeh ke Parwardigar is ke khilaaf chaahe. Yeh Khuda ki ek ata hai jo khatm hone waali nahin hai

Lihaaza Khuda ke ilaawa jis ki bhi yeh parastish karte hain us ki taraf se aap kisi shubhe mein na padein. Yeh isi tarah parastish kar rahe hain jis tarah un ke baap daada kar rahe the, aur hum inhein poora poora hissa baghair kisi kami ke denge

Aur hum ne Moosa ko kitaab di to us mein bhi ikhtilaaf paida kar diya gaya, aur agar tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se pehle baat na ho gayi hoti to un ke darmiyaan faisla kar diya jaata, aur yeh log us azaab ki taraf se shak mein pade hue hain
Aur yaqeenan tumhaara Parwardigar sab ke aamaal ka poora poora badla dega, aur woh un sab ke aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Lihaaza aap ko jis tarah hukm diya gaya hai isi tarah istiqaamat se kaam lein, aur woh bhi jinhon ne aap ke saath tauba kar li hai, aur koi kisi tarah ki ziyaadati na kare, ke Khuda sab ke aamaal ko khoob dekhne waala hai
Aur khabardaar tum log zaalimon ki taraf jhukaao ikhtiyaar na karna ke Jahannam ki aag tumhein chhoo legi, aur Khuda ke ilaawa tumhaara koi sarparast nahin hoga aur tumhaari madad bhi nahin ki jaaegi
Aur Paighambar! Aap din ke donon hisson mein aur raat gaye namaaz qaaim karein, ke nekiyaan buraaiyon ko khatm kar dene waali hain, aur yeh zikr-e-Khuda karne waalon ke liye ek naseehat hai
Aur aap sabr se kaam lein ke Khuda nek amal karne waalon ke ajr ko zaaya nahin karta hai

To tumhaare pehle waale zamaanon aur naslon mein aise saahibaan-e-aql kyon nahin paida hue hain jo logon ko zameen mein fasaad phailaane se rokte, ilaawa un chand afraad ke jinhein hum ne najaat de di, aur zaalim to apne aish hi ke peechhe pade rahe aur yeh sab ke sab mujrim the
Aur aap ke Parwardigar ka kaam yeh nahin hai ke kisi qarye ko zulm kar ke tabaah kar de jab ke us ke rehne waale islaah karne waale hon
Aur agar aap ka Parwardigar chaah leta to saare insaanon ko ek qaum bana deta (lekin woh jabr nahin karta hai), lihaaza yeh hamesha mukhtalif hi rahenge
Ilaawa un ke jin par Khuda ne reham kar diya ho, aur isi liye inhein paida kiya hai, aur aap ke Parwardigar ki yeh baat qat'i haq hai ke hum Jahannam ko insaanon aur jinnon se bhar kar rahenge

Aur hum qadeem rasoolon ke waaqe'aat aap se bayaan kar rahe hain ke un ke zariye aap ke dil ko mazboot rakhein, aur un waaqe'aat mein haq, naseehat aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye saamaan-e-ibrat bhi hai
Aur aap un be-imaanon se keh dein ke tum apni jagah par kaam karo aur hum apni jagah par apna kaam kar rahe hain
Aur phir intizaar karo ke hum bhi intizaar karne waale hain

Aur Allah hi ke liye aasmaan aur zameen ka kul ghaib hai aur usi ki taraf tamaam umoor ki baazgasht hai, lihaaza aap usi ki ibaadat karein aur usi par e'temaad karein, ke aap ka Rab logon ke aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai
